capabilities: extract highlighted passages from the active note into a new note
run extraction via a ribbon icon or command palette command
optionally delete the original note after extraction
choose a destination folder for the extracted note
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to distill a long note down to only its highlighted passages in a separate note.
summary: Highlight extractor that pulls every ==highlighted== passage from the active note into a new, clean note.
